units.upstream: shell finishes when send() on a pipeline pipe fails after the writer started
units.note: Upstream injects ENOMEM into send() on the pipeline socketpair via an LD_PRELOAD shim (SHELL_FAIL_SEND=1) and expects {exitCode: 0, stdout: ''} with no hang; the fault injection is Bun-internal. Without the fault the subshell's three echoes reach cat.

template: (echo one; echo two; echo three) | cat
